educationalGoal: The brain and nervous system are the basis of human mental function. (1) the structure of the brain and nervous system. (2) localization of brain function. (3) noninvasive measurement of the human brain. (4) recent study on cognitive neuroscience. (5) symptoms of higher brain dysfunction.
